preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[:3]) and len(stdin.split()) >= 3
preconditions.description: The first line contains three integers n, m, q where 1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5, 1 ≤ m ≤ 3e5, and 1 ≤ q ≤ 5e5.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[3:3+n]) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[3:3+n]) and len(set(stdin.split()[3:3+n])) == n
preconditions.description: The second line contains n distinct integers p_1, ..., p_n where each p_i is in [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) >= 3 + n + m and all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n and int(a) != int(b) for a, b in zip(stdin.split()[3+n::2], stdin.split()[4+n::2]))
preconditions.description: The next m lines describe edges (a_i, b_i) where 1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n and a_i ≠ b_i, with no multi-edges.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and (line.split()[0] == '1' or line.split()[0] == '2') for line in stdin.split()[3+n+m:].split('\n') if line.strip())
preconditions.description: The next q lines are queries: type 1 v (1 ≤ v ≤ n) or type 2 i (1 ≤ i ≤ m), with no duplicate edge deletions.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in [str(p) for p in p_initial + [0]] for stdout_line in stdout.split() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output is a value p_u from the current p array (including 0) of a reachable vertex u from v in the current graph.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '0' or (int(stdout_line.strip()) in p_initial and p_initial.index(int(stdout_line.strip())) in reachable_vertices)) for stdout_line, query in zip(stdout.split(), stdin.split()[3+n+m:].split('\n')) if query.strip().startswith('1'))
postconditions.description: For each query 1 v, the output p_u is the maximum p value in the connected component of v (or 0 if all are 0), and p_u is set to 0 afterward.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '0' or (int(stdout_line.strip()) in p_initial and p_initial.index(int(stdout_line.strip())) in reachable_vertices)) for stdout_line, query in zip(stdout.split(), stdin.split()[3+n+m:].split('\n')) if query.strip().startswith('1'))
postconditions.description: If all reachable vertices from v have p_u = 0, the output is 0 (no requirement on which vertex is chosen).

invariants.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p_current) and len(set(p_current)) <= n and sum(p_current) <= n * n
invariants.description: At all times, p_current is a list of length n where each p_i is in [0, n] (initially distinct and in [1, n]).

invariants.expression: all(1 <= i <= m and (a_i, b_i) in edges_remaining for i in range(1, m+1))
invariants.description: Edges_remaining is a set of undirected edges (a_i, b_i) where 1 ≤ i ≤ m, and only edges not deleted by type-2 queries remain.
